title: Full forward sweep
statement: Let $I$ be an index type, let $f:\mathbb Z\to I\to\mathrm{OblPayload}$ be a payload family, let $z\in\mathbb Z$, and let $n\in\mathbb N$. Folding the forward row transducer over the uncached zone of length $n$ starting at $z$, with initial register $f(z-1)$, yields register $f(z+n-1)$ and the cached zone of length $n$ starting at $z$.
replaced:
For every payload family, coordinate $z$, and length $n$, folding the forward
transducer with initial register the payloads at $z - 1$ over the uncached zone of $n$
rows starting at $z$ ends with register the payloads at $z + n - 1$ and produces the
cached zone of the same $n$ rows; all left-neighbor caches are installed.
